c.description:
Furnished 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom duplex in Kitsilano — 2115 MacDonald St, at W. 5th Ave and McDonald St. 1,365 sq ft.

Available December 1, 2026. Short-term rentals of 3+ months considered — ideal for a visiting scholar, postdoc, or faculty family.

$5,250/month — all utilities included: water, heat, natural gas, electricity, and internet. Cable TV not included.

Includes 1 parking spot, in-suite laundry, gas fireplace, gas stove, dishwasher, and central vacuum. Two bedrooms and a full bath downstairs, private master suite with ensuite upstairs.

No pets, no smoking. Max occupancy 4.

Half a month's rent as security deposit. Tenant's insurance required. Credit check, reference check, and last landlord contact required.
